display_long_description:
Your family. Your street. Your call.

A LIVING DOLLHOUSE
Look down on your home with the roof lifted off. Dan, Maya, Lily and Max each have six needs: hunger, energy, hygiene, bladder, fun and social. Leave them alone and they look after themselves. Point your laser at anyone and tell them what to do: cook dinner, take a shower, watch TV, play chess, tend the garden, go to bed.

STEP INSIDE
Press A and you are standing in the room at life size. Walk the house, sit with the family on the sofa, then step back out and tower over the street again. Grab a family member with GRIP and set them down anywhere.

A WHOLE NEIGHBOURHOOD
Six neighbour homes you can walk into, each with people living their own lives. Neighbours ring the bell, come over to visit and turn up for your parties. There is a park with a playground and a duck pond, a corner cafe, Joe's Garage with a car up on the lift, and traffic that stops at the crossing.

WORK, SCHOOL AND MONEY
Jobs and school on weekdays, promotions, bills on Mondays and Thursdays, and pizza delivered to your door. Spend what they earn on new furniture and place it yourself.

SKILLS, FRIENDS AND GOALS
Cooking, charisma, logic, gardening and painting grow as they use them, and paintings sell. Friendships rise with every chat. Twelve family goals pay cash rewards.

DAY, NIGHT AND WEATHER
The sun crosses the sky, lamps come on at dusk and rainy days keep everyone indoors. Pause, play or fast-forward time from the home board.
